seo_title: AI for Migrating Legacy Code | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Trapped in obsolete code? We implement an AI Agent that audits, refactors, and migrates your B2B legacy software to modern architectures without downtime.
author_pitch: I have spent over a decade dealing with monolithic systems. I have designed Artificial Intelligence agents that read, understand, and rewrite obsolete code so your technical team can stop putting out fires and return to innovating.
title: AI Refactoring Agent: Modernize Your Legacy Software Without Pausing Your Business
body:
Is your company paralyzed by obsolete software that no one dares to touch?

In the B2B sector, maintaining legacy systems written ten years ago is a ticking time bomb. Every new feature takes months to launch, senior developers spend 80% of their day resolving critical bugs, and the fear of breaking something in production completely stalls your business growth. Technical debt is costing you thousands of dollars in wasted talent and lost opportunities.

The trap of manual migrations

Hiring an army of consultants to rewrite your system from scratch usually ends in endless projects, doubled budgets, and parallel systems that never truly synchronize. Old code is not rewritten with more hands, it is mastered with structured intelligence.

Our solution: B2B AI Refactoring Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we have developed workflows based on LLMs specialized in reverse engineering. Our AI Agent audits your repository, understands the business logic embedded in your monolith, and generates automated Pull Requests to migrate dependencies, translate languages, and extract microservices clinically.

  1. Hidden Dependency Mapping: The AI scans millions of lines to create a relationship graph and detect which modules are tightly coupled.
  2. Code and Syntax Translation: Automatically converts obsolete frameworks to modern technologies while keeping the B2B business logic perfectly intact.
  3. Unit Test Generation: The agent writes exhaustive tests for the legacy code before refactoring it, ensuring no functionality is lost.
  4. Safe Incremental Deployment: Isolates and extracts microservices one by one, allowing your platform to continue operating at 100% throughout the entire transition.

The Real Impact on your IT Operations

  • Time-to-Market Acceleration: Reduces code migrations that previously blocked your team for years down to mere weeks.
  • Technical Talent Retention: Frees your engineers from tedious maintenance tasks so they can design the features your clients demand.
  • Vulnerability Elimination: Automatically updates critical dependencies, closing security gaps that put your company data at risk.
